source_text:
domain define-pack-readiness "Define Definition Pack readiness"
profile declarative-function-v1
owner cyberalchemy-define-owner
logic sfol-v1

schema PackFacts:
  version_supported: boolean
  identity_complete: boolean
  scope_complete: boolean
  concepts_present: boolean
  dispositions_exact: boolean
  dispositions_declared: boolean
  authority_none: boolean
  language_quality_pass: boolean
  language_evidence_complete: boolean
  open_questions_empty: boolean

schema PackDecision:
  status: string pattern "^(invalid|valid_open|handoff_ready)$"
  valid: boolean
  handoff_ready: boolean
  session_state: string pattern "^(validation-blocked|blocked-open-meaning|definition-pack-complete)$"
  authority_effect: string const "none"

mapping PackInvalid:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-PACK-INVALID"
  meaning "Block a Definition Pack with any structural, language-quality, disposition, or authority defect."
  target PackDecision
  field status = "invalid"
  field valid = false
  field handoff_ready = false
  field session_state = "validation-blocked"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping PackValidOpen:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-PACK-VALID-OPEN"
  meaning "Keep a structurally valid pack blocked on its visible open meaning."
  target PackDecision
  field status = "valid_open"
  field valid = true
  field handoff_ready = false
  field session_state = "blocked-open-meaning"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping PackHandoffReady:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-PACK-HANDOFF-READY"
  meaning "Mark a structurally valid pack with no open meaning ready for a separately governed consumer handoff."
  target PackDecision
  field status = "handoff_ready"
  field valid = true
  field handoff_ready = true
  field session_state = "definition-pack-complete"
  field authority_effect = "none"

rule PackHasDefect:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-PACK-HAS-DEFECT"
  meaning "At least one required Definition Pack fact is false."
  condition not (input.version_supported and input.identity_complete and input.scope_complete and input.concepts_present and input.dispositions_exact and input.dispositions_declared and input.authority_none and input.language_quality_pass and input.language_evidence_complete)

rule PackIsValidWithOpenMeaning:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-PACK-VALID-WITH-OPEN-MEANING"
  meaning "All validation facts pass while one or more open questions remain."
  condition input.version_supported and input.identity_complete and input.scope_complete and input.concepts_present and input.dispositions_exact and input.dispositions_declared and input.authority_none and input.language_quality_pass and input.language_evidence_complete and input.open_questions_empty == false

rule PackIsHandoffReady:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-PACK-IS-HANDOFF-READY"
  meaning "All validation facts pass and no open question remains."
  condition input.version_supported and input.identity_complete and input.scope_complete and input.concepts_present and input.dispositions_exact and input.dispositions_declared and input.authority_none and input.language_quality_pass and input.language_evidence_complete and input.open_questions_empty

result EvaluatePackReadiness:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-EVALUATE-PACK-READINESS"
  meaning "Select structural validity and session posture without approving the pack's meaning."
  when PackHasDefect yield PackInvalid
  when PackIsValidWithOpenMeaning yield PackValidOpen
  when PackIsHandoffReady yield PackHandoffReady

endpoint DefinePackReadiness:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/define/pack-readiness"
  input PackFacts
  output PackDecision
  result EvaluatePackReadiness
  auth-env DEFINE_RUNTIME_TOKEN
  max-bytes 16384
  timeout-ms 1000
  error-status 422
  status invalid 422
  status valid_open 409
  status handoff_ready 200
